title: Understanding LASSO Regularization
text: LASSO regularization adds a penalty equal to the absolute value of the magnitude of coefficients. This can lead to some coefficients being exactly zero, effectively selecting a simpler model. How might this affect the model's performance on unseen data?

title: Impact on Model Bias
text: Consider how reducing the complexity of a model by setting some coefficients to zero might affect the model's bias. Does it increase or decrease?

title: Effect on Model Variance
text: Think about how a simpler model with fewer parameters might influence the model's variance. Would it be more stable or more sensitive to changes in the data?

title: Possible Effects on MSE
text: What are the possible effects of using LASSO regularization on the MSE of held-out test data?
